Name: Em's Traveling Cart
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
A new cart for the travelling merchant!
Including the merchant's pig and three festival carts
Seasonal details are optional, available for Content Patcher
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39057]Cornucopia Cooking Recipes[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/GpC3tsrq/Cart-Config.png[/img]

The cart is decorated with seasonal details that change with time
To disable this, change "[color=#e69138]true[/color]" to "[color=#e69138]false[/color]" in the [i]config.json[/i]

Spring: Daffodils are covering the cart
Summer: A second lantern and bird
Fall: A rusty key and cobwebs hang by the door, and leaves cover the roof
Winter: A north star hangs on the front, and snow covers the cart

Festivals where the traveling cart can be found are:
Desert festival during spring 15/16/17
Festival of Ice during winter 8
Night Market during winter 15/16/17

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/yYmJCDCW/Cornucopia.png[/img]

The file includes an optional patch for the Chef Cart from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39057]Cornucopia Cooking Recipes[/url]
This is the small cart hitched to the back of the travelling cart
The Chef Cart has no seasonal decoration and remains the same all year round
To disable the Chef Cart, change "[color=#e69138]true[/color]" to "[color=#e69138]false[/color]" in the[i] config.json[/i]
If you don't have Cornucopia installed, the patch won't affect your game

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Traveling Cart CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]

[i]Update 1.1 Patch added for the Chef Cart of Cornucopia Cooking Recipes[/i]

Note that if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39616]Em's Large Critters[/url] installed, disable the "Traveling Cart Pig"
They will be removed from the critter mod file in a planned update soon
Thank you, BitterBloom and HarrisonGrey, for helping me with the Cornucopia patch!
And of course, a shout out to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2821799]MizuJakkaru[/url] for the well-loved expansion of Cornucopia itself
